title: Advisory Solutions Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Your Role and Responsibilities
  
  
Solutions Engineers at Confluent play a critical role across the customer journey. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, risks, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures that clearly connect Confluent capabilities to customer outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform strategy.
* Own and drive technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and proof of value activities from initial scope through technical win.
* Run workshops, white boarding sessions, and architecture discussions with developers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders.
* Help customers adopt best practices for data streaming, cloud, hybrid, and event-driven architectures as they move from individual projects toward broader platform adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success to remove blockers, shape solutions, and improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to account strategy with Account Executives by helping qualify opportunities, build champions, and strengthen the technical and business case for change.
* Create reusable assets such as demos, presentations, reference architectures, discovery patterns, or enablement material that scale beyond a single account.
* Mentor other Solutions Engineers by sharing best practices, giving constructive feedback, and helping lift the technical quality of the wider team.

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.
* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

title: Part time - AWS WorkSpaces Migration Architect
description:
We’re Hiring: AWS WorkSpaces Migration Architect
  
  
  
We are looking for an experienced AWS WorkSpaces Migration Architect to lead enterprise EUC/VDI migration initiatives, design scalable desktop environments, and drive infrastructure automation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architecture & Migration Leadership
  
  
- Lead discovery, assessment, sizing, dependency mapping, and migration planning.
  
- Design migration waves, pilot deployments, cutover strategies, rollback procedures, and transition plans.
  
  
AWS WorkSpaces Architecture
  
  
- Design and deploy AWS WorkSpaces Personal (Persistent) and WorkSpaces Pools (Non-Persistent).
  
- Design desktop pools based on workload personas and business requirements.
  
- Define scaling, capacity planning, high availability, and disaster recovery strategies.
  
- Optimize user experience, profile management, and desktop performance.
  
  
Persistent & Non-Persistent Desktop Architecture
  
  
- Design profile persistence using FSLogix, User Profile Disks, Profile Containers, and Amazon FSx.
  
- Work with app layering technologies and recommend persistent, non-persistent, or hybrid desktop models.
  
- Optimize application delivery, user personalization, and data management.
  
  
Image Engineering & Infrastructure Automation
  
  
- Establish enterprise Golden Image strategies and image lifecycle management.
  
- Develop and maintain Terraform modules for AWS WorkSpaces, VPC, and IAM.
  
- Build automated image creation, testing, and deployment pipelines.
  
- Implement GitOps methodologies and integrate IaC with enterprise release management.
  
  
CI/CD & Automation
  
  
- Build and manage CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and AWS CodePipeline.
  
- Automate compliance validation, testing, and release approvals.
  
  
Required Technical Skills
  
  
- Strong expertise in AWS WorkSpaces and EUC/VDI technologies.
  
- Expert-level Terraform skills; CloudFormation knowledge preferred.
  
- Experience with FSLogix, App Volumes, and DEM.
  
- Strong understanding of GitOps methodologies and Infrastructure as Code.
  
- Hands-on experience with Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, and Git.
  
- Expertise in Windows 10/11 Enterprise, Golden Image Management, image automation, optimization, and application packaging.
  
  
Interested candidates: Please share your updated resume or reach out via direct message.

title: Business Development Manager | AWS Sales
description:
Position Summary:
  
  
Cloud BDM will be responsible for driving growth in Ingram Micro’s cloud business through channel partners, vendors, and end customers. This role involves identifying new cloud opportunities, building strategic relationships, executing go-to-market plans, and ensuring revenue & margin targets are met. The BDM must combine technical understanding of cloud services with sales acumen in a partner / distribution environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and execute growth strategies to increase cloud market share (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, professional/managed services)
* Identify new market segments, verticals, and geographies for cloud adoption
* Develop annual/quarterly plans and forecasts for cloud business
* Coordinate with cloud vendors (AWS, Azure, Google, etc.) for promotions, rebates, partner programs
* Align and run joint GTM campaigns and demand-gen activities
* Leverage vendor funding and incentives (e.g. MAP, OLA) to drive adoption
* Own end-to-end sales cycles for key cloud deals.
* Work with presales / solution architects to framework proposals, RFP responses, PoCs
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, SLAs and close deals
* Understand and promote ancillary cloud services: migrations, modernization, security, cost optimization, managed services
* Work with internal teams to build scalable repeatable service models
* Ensure quality of cloud delivery through alignment with operations / service teams
* Collaborate with marketing to design demand generation campaigns, events, webinars, content
* Participate in industry events, conferences, and represent Ingram Micro publicly Required Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field
* MBA / Postgraduate degree is a plus

Work Experience
  
  

* 4 – 8+ years in cloud sales / IT services / solution sales / business development
* Experience in channel / partner sales / distribution environment is preferred
* Track record of meeting or exceeding sales / revenue / margin targets
* Experience with cloud vendors (AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar) and their partner programs
* Familiarity with cloud services (migration, modernization, security, managed services)
* Exposure to large / enterprise deals and deal structuring

Skills & Attributes
  
  

* Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills
* Strong analytical mindset and data-driven decision making
* Ability to build relationships at multiple levels (vendors, partners, customers)
* Strategic and commercial acumen, with ability to see both big picture and execution detail
* Self-motivated, result-oriented and entrepreneurial mindset
* Ability to work in fast-paced, ambiguous environment
* Flexibility to travel as needed

Certifications (Desirable)
  
  

* AWS / Azure / GCP Associate or Professional certifications
* Partner / Cloud vendor program certifications
